title: yTax structured errors and refusals
description: Errors are structured: {code, message, field_path?, manifest_ref?}. Refusals name a boundary and point at the coverage manifest — never a guess. Honest refusal is a feature.

refusal.description: A structured refusal carried in the envelope's refusals[].

boundary.description: The named boundary that was hit (e.g. a form/situation not covered).

manifest_ref.description: Pointer into the coverage manifest for this boundary.

words.description: for a KNOCKOUT, the dictionary's own sentence for the boundary — what a person reads; the path stays in `boundary` as the machine key.
